newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Moussa leaves for France and Norway.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Moussa leaves for France and Norway.

text.p: Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa left Cairo on Wednesday morning for a three-day tour that will take him to France and Norway, airport sources said.
Moussa's tour comes within the framework of an Egyptian diplomatic campaign to save Middle East peace talks, Egyptian officials said.
Moussa is expected to meet French Foreign Minister Herve De Charette and Norwegian Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland and Foreign Minister Bjoern Tore Godal, the sources added.
Moussa may also visit Britain, under attack in Egypt because it has not prevented Islamist militants from holding a conference in London on September 8.
"A visit (to London) is possible during this tour but I cannot be definite about that now," Egyptian assistant foreign minister Fathi el-Shazli told reporters earlier this week.
Egypt has set five conditions for Israel to meet if a Middle East economic conference is to go ahead in Cairo in November.
One of the aims of the diplomatic campaign is to put pressure on Israel to meet those conditions.
